# openwrt_dropbear (Resource)

The dropbear SSH server instance (`config dropbear`).

Manages a `dropbear` section in `/etc/config/dropbear`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `banner_file` (String) Banner shown before login. (UCI option `BannerFile`.)
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable this instance. (UCI option `enable`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `gateway_ports` (Boolean) Allow remote hosts to connect to forwarded ports. (UCI option `GatewayPorts`.)
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle timeout in seconds. (UCI option `IdleTimeout`.)
- `interface` (String) Listen only on this logical interface. (UCI option `Interface`.)
- `keyfile` (List of String) Host key files. (UCI option `keyfile`.)
- `max_auth_tries` (Number) Maximum authentication attempts. (UCI option `MaxAuthTries`.)
- `password_auth` (Boolean) Allow password logins. (UCI option `PasswordAuth`.)
- `port` (Number) Listen port. (UCI option `Port`.)
- `root_login` (Boolean) Allow root logins. (UCI option `RootLogin`.)
- `root_password_auth` (Boolean) Allow root password logins. (UCI option `RootPasswordAuth`.)
- `ssh_keep_alive` (Number) Keepalive interval in seconds. (UCI option `SSHKeepAlive`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
